description.p: Infiltrator Software provides one coherent surface for discovering, installing, updating and repairing software while keeping package-system mechanics isolated behind replaceable backend contracts.

The Linux implementation merges verified Infiltrator catalogue records, host AppStream applications and configured Flatpak metadata while presenting Discover, Installed, Updates, System, Repositories, History and Repair in one application.
Makes navigation atomic and paints Discover before starting its lazy catalogue refresh, preventing mixed History/Discover transition frames.
Moves package-list refresh into an isolated per-user cache and keeps administrator authorization at the actual package-mutation boundary.
Unifies the running window, About dialog, Cinnamon taskbar and Software Manager on the canonical project-owned application icon.
Operational APT updates with preflight transaction planning, constrained Polkit execution and a Mint-native XApp panel status indicator.
Fixes AppStream ownership in the merged Discover catalogue while retaining integrated APT and Flatpak source discovery.
Separates native AppStream and Flatpak catalogue ingestion for a stable unified Discover view.
Unified Infiltrator, AppStream and Flatpak discovery with live repository inventory and integrated source addition.
Fixes the Discover startup model-lifetime crash and adds a permanent graphical launch smoke test.
Discover now renders catalogue metadata immediately and hydrates verified icons asynchronously.
Real Discover catalogue with verified repository metadata, search, categories, icon caching and application details.
Common 1.19.10 semantic palette, InfiltratorFS typography scale and corrected title-bar contrast.
InfiltratorFS-aligned native shell with integrated Common theme controls and refined application chrome.
Initial read-only foundation with Common 1.19.8 theming, APT inventory and verified Debian packaging.
